# Refactor buddy

Refactors code in small steps and keeps tests green after every step.

## Install

```
/plugin marketplace add demo_nimbus-labs/agent-marketplace
/plugin install refactor-buddy@nimbus-plugins
```

## Usage

Example: extract this function and rename the variables.

# Refactor Buddy

## Steps
1. Run the tests first.
2. Make one small change.
3. Run the tests again.
4. Commit and repeat.
